text:
haley.docs: Starting a small docs PR train to tidy up function/tool-calling + structured-output examples. Aim: canonicalize two envelope examples (invoice + user_intent), add a compact envelope for mobile, and land a short guardrails checklist. Opening PR in ~30m.

samir.eng: Sounds good. Can you list which SDK examples you want changed? I can take Python and node.

haley.docs: Plan:
- Canonical JSON schema for `invoice` and `user_intent`
- Compact envelope example for low-bandwidth clients (no verbose schema inline)
- Guardrails: explicit fallback policy (schema validate -> partial parse -> raw text)
- Consumer test snippet for CI (validator + graceful fallback)
- Link sweep: update two anchors under parsing patterns that moved during site reorg

anna-devex: I'll author TS + Python snippet updates. Do we want the compact envelope to use a `schema_ref` pointer to a central JSON file? That keeps docs light.
jess.prod: +1 for schema_ref. Also add a short note about telemetry: tag examples with `example:canonical-v1` so later we can detect drift in evals.

samir.eng: Quick dev note: the runtime parser harness normalizes integers to numbers and trims trailing zeros in decimals; our sample outputs should reflect that or tests will fail. I'll run a couple prompts and paste the raw outputs into the PR.

haley.docs: Great. Add an "Observed vs expected" mini-table in the PR for any discrepant outputs. Also include this one-liner for reviewers to run locally: `./dev/tools/parse-check --schema docs/schemas/invoice.json --prompts examples/invoice_prompts.txt`

anna-devex: Drafted an example compact envelope using `schema_ref` and a tiny invocation shape. Will push in a follow-up commit. Example:
```json
{"tool_call": {"name":"fetch_invoice","arguments":{"id":"INV-2026"}}, "structured_output":{"schema_ref":"/schemas/invoice.json"}}
```

jess.prod: Can we add a "gotchas" bullet about nullable arrays and `oneOf` unions? Those came up in support tickets.

haley.docs: Yes 100%. Adding a short note under guardrails: prefer explicit `type` unions, avoid ambiguous `oneOf` where possible, and show an example fallback for `nullable` arrays.

samir.eng: I'll also add a compact sample for streaming responses (how tool-call + streaming chunks should be annotated).

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4531 by haley.docs

haley.docs: Assigning reviewers: @anna-devex, @samir.eng, @jess.prod. Target merge: Tues EOD provided CI + lint pass.

anna-devex: I'll update the SDK snippets and run the docs-lint check before pushing. Command I used: `make docs-lint && python tooling/snippet_validator.py --path docs/structured-output`

haley.docs: Thanks everyone. After merge, mike-rls can canary the site render; if compact envelope examples collapse the layout we'll tweak formatting. I'll follow up with the PR link once the first commit is up.
